label: Advanced Beginner
knowledge-base: Begins to see connections between actions and outcomes
key-focus: Starts to adapt to specific situations

label: Competent
key-focus: Prioritizes and manages multiple aspects of care

label: Expert
key-focus: No longer relies on rules or guidelines

label: Empiricism
description: Values observation and perception by sense
Relies on instrumentation, reliability, and validation

label: Positivism
description: Complex things are reduced to basic components
core-belief: The goal of science is to explain, predict, and control
Facts can be measured and observed

label: Post-Positivism
description: Focus on rigor and objective inquiry through quantitative methods
core-belief: Objective reality exists but is imperfectly known

label: Phenomenology
description: Seeks to understand the meaning of human experience
core-belief: Knowledge is grounded in human experience

label: Constructivism
description: Knowledge is subjective and created by individuals
core-belief: Emphasis on subjectivity, multiple truths, trends, and patterns

label: Postmodernism
description: Rejects a single truth — multiple meanings and ways of knowing
core-belief: Knowledge is uncertain, contextual, and relative — changes over time
